tasks.title: Create app/services/freshness.py — FreshnessAccessor cache, row-absent error, warning log
tasks.notes: Class FreshnessAccessor(session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession] | None = None), defaulting to app.core.db.SessionLocal (mirrors PersonaResolver's D-06 injectable seam). get_last_successful_run() -> datetime: warm-hit fast path (no lock) on a non-expired _cached_value/_expiry pair; miss path acquires an asyncio.Lock, re-checks (double-check), then issues select(SystemMetadata).where(SystemMetadata.key == 'ingestion').limit(1) via scalar_one_or_none(). Row present -> cache (value, time.monotonic() + _CACHE_TTL_SECONDS) and return last_successful_run_at unchanged (timezone-aware, no reformatting). Row absent -> logger.warning() with the module constant _NOT_RUN_MESSAGE = 'ingestion job may not have run yet' as the log message (extra={'reason': 'system_metadata row not found'}), then raise HTTPException(status_code=500, detail=_NOT_RUN_MESSAGE); never cache the absent outcome (D-03) so the next call re-queries. _CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 300.0 is a local, private module constant (D-02) — do not import persona_resolver's. No log on the warm-hit path (REQUIREMENTS.md NFR Observability declines it explicitly). Module docstring must record, per REQUIREMENTS.md § Documentation requirements: (a) no writer exists yet, so AC-4 is fixture-verified until ING-02 (research risk #1/R-01), and (b) the 500-over-503 status choice (BED-04-FR-1/R-05).

tasks.title: Add tests/unit/test_freshness.py — row-present/absent + cache-mechanics coverage (TC-01, TC-02)
tasks.notes: BED-04-TC-01 and BED-04-TC-02 both need a live, migrated Postgres (their own preconditions: 'Test database migrated to head') — use tests/conftest.py's migrated_db/test_session/test_engine fixtures, matching test_persona_resolver.py's TC-03/14 live-DB pattern. TC-01: seed system_metadata(key='ingestion', last_successful_run_at=<fixed ts>), construct a fresh FreshnessAccessor(session_factory=async_sessionmaker(bind=test_engine)), assert the returned datetime is tz-aware, UTC-offset +00:00, and equals the seeded value; assert no WARNING record was emitted. TC-02: leave system_metadata empty for 'ingestion', attach a logging handler directly to the app.services.freshness logger (test_persona_resolver.py's 'Log-capture idiom' — immune to configure_logging()+capsys), call the accessor, assert the raised HTTPException.status_code == 500 and str(detail) matches the imported app.services.freshness._NOT_RUN_MESSAGE constant byte-exactly (not a re-typed literal), and assert exactly one WARNING record was captured whose message is the same constant with no PII field. Additionally (not in docs/test-cases/BED-04.json — authored here per that file's coverage_audit note that unit-shaped cache mechanics belong in this plan): a pure-mock test using a FakeSessionFactory (mirrors test_persona_resolver.py's _FakeRow/_FakeResult) proving a warm cache hit performs zero session_factory calls, and a concurrency test proving N concurrent cold get_last_successful_run() calls against one instance issue exactly one underlying SELECT (lock double-check, D-01).

tasks.title: Add tests/perf/test_freshness_perf.py — warm-read + TTL-expiry boundary (TC-03)
tasks.notes: BED-04-TC-03, structured like tests/perf/test_persona_resolver_perf.py (plain time.perf_counter(), no benchmark tool; local _percentile copy per that file's own precedent of not sharing a perf_utils module until a third copy would justify it). Needs a live migrated Postgres (migrated_db/test_engine/test_session). Steps: seed system_metadata(key='ingestion', last_successful_run_at=2026-09-03T09:15:00+00:00); call the accessor once to populate the cache; attach a before_cursor_execute listener on test_engine.sync_engine scoped to SELECTs against system_metadata (mirrors test_rollup_rebuild_query_plan.py's _count_usage_events_selects) and record the count; UPDATE system_metadata.last_successful_run_at to 2026-09-03T09:47:00+00:00 directly via test_session (simulating the out-of-process ingest write); monkeypatch app.services.freshness.time.monotonic with a controllable fake clock (module-level `import time` in freshness.py, so monkeypatch.setattr(freshness.time, 'monotonic', fake) intercepts it) and advance it 299s; call the accessor 200 times timing each with time.perf_counter(), assert every call returns the original 09:15:00 value, assert the SELECT count is unchanged (0 additional queries), and assert p95 < 10ms; advance the fake clock past 301s total; call once more, assert it returns the updated 09:47:00 value and the SELECT count increased by exactly 1. No production-logging fixture needed (unlike test_persona_resolver_perf.py's TC-12) because REQUIREMENTS.md's Observability NFR explicitly omits a log on the warm-hit path.
